emailVerification.subject: Verify your Mini Shop account
emailVerification.instruction: Please verify your email address to activate your account. This link can only be used once and will expire soon.
emailVerification.footer: If you did not create this account, you can safely ignore this email.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your Mini Shop password
passwordReset.instruction: We received a request to reset your password. This link can only be used once and will expire soon.
passwordReset.footer: If you did not request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email.

orderPlaced.subject: Order {orderId} has been placed
orderPlaced.body: Thank you for your order. We have received order {orderId} for a total of {totalVnd} VND and it is now pending confirmation.
orderPlaced.footer: You can check your order status anytime from your account.

orderConfirmed.subject: Order {orderId} has been confirmed
orderConfirmed.body: Your order {orderId} has been confirmed and is being prepared for delivery.
orderConfirmed.footer: You can check your order status anytime from your account.

orderRejected.subject: Order {orderId} has been rejected
orderRejected.body: We are sorry, but your order {orderId} has been rejected for the following reason: {rejectionReason}
orderRejected.footer: If you have any questions, please contact our support team.

monthlyRevenue.subject: Monthly revenue report — {period}
monthlyRevenue.body: Total revenue from COMPLETED orders in {period} was {totalRevenueVnd} VND.
monthlyRevenue.footer: This is an automated monthly report.
